_readme: Written by the Cowork laptop task. Board reads this every 15 min. Keep newest first: the 5 most recent original posts from each of Man City and Premier League, 10 total, interleaved by timestamp. 'time' is the post's UTC timestamp; the board renders GST.

posts.text: A message from our hat-trick hero 💬🩵
Howard Webb breaks down the decision to show Rodrigo Bentancur a red card against Man Utd 👉 premierleague.app.link/e/UY1vUesFo7b

A proud night for our Academy in the #UCL 🩵💫

Three debuts ✅
Three goals ⚽️
Four assists 🅰️

Alexis Mac Allister scored twice as @LFC completed a dramatic Champions League comeback against Villareal ⚽️⚽️

Florian Wirtz and Ronald Araujo also scored as the Reds came from 2-0 down to win 4-3 at Anfield! 🔁

Elliot Anderson scored his first goal for @ManCity in their Champions League victory against AEK Athens ⚽️

Phil Foden scored a hat-trick and Rayan Cherki was on the scoresheet in the 5-1 win.

Scintillating strikes in Matchweek 7 😍

Presented by Guinness

“My name is Igor Thiago and I’m from Cidade Ocidentale.” 🇧🇷

Following the footsteps of icons before him, @BrentfordFC’s proud No 9 is proof that greatness comes from everywhere. 🌎
